monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral air-monitor decision system covering sensor purpose, performance evidence, display, logging, export, privacy, outage behavior, upkeep, return testing, and first-year cost. It adds no merchant, model, price, coupon, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves existing-alarm, source-control, and no-purchase outcomes.

image_qa.note: Both new guides and the semantic table-header control use text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No person, blood product, monitor, sensor, alarm, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report showed 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. ‘510 vs disposable’ had two impressions at position 12, while Delaware, federal-property, and Montana signals had one impression or click apiece; those samples were too weak to redirect the portfolio and existing pages already serve the intents. Blue Dream had 18 impressions near position 45 and was also not used to create another strain variation. No item is primarily Data-led. The report acted as a cannibalization guard while this batch fills distinct donor-eligibility, indoor-air shopping, and accessibility gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy U.S. blood-donation eligibility decision guide anchored by current American Red Cross and FDA materials. Its five-lane screen, synthetic-cannabinoid distinction, donor-prep record, center call script, and myth checks strengthen responsible-use, clinician-conversation, and cardiovascular-safety paths through reciprocal contextual links. The table-header release gate also improves the accessibility of every comparison and evidence matrix on the site. No tightly matched unsolicited outreach target was strong enough to log, and no outreach was sent.
